title: ElectroFast
description: R/Shiny application for electrochemical data from any potentiostat: surface area, cyclic voltammetry, Tafel analysis, pulse voltammetry, chronoamperometry, chronopotentiometry, RDE/RRDE, impedance fitting, ISE calibration, selectivity, precision and QC charts, with HTML, PDF and PowerPoint reports. Free for academic, educational and noncommercial research use. Commercial use requires permission.
